commands.name: CreateLocalTask
steps: validate bounded name and optional complete positive-duration schedule; convert local schedule via OBJECTIVE_TIMEZONE_V1 before writer lock

pure-preflight validate each optional relationship selection as canonical UUIDv4 text, reject duplicates, canonical-sort each selection for COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 hashing, and reject combined creation-time selection above bounds.json create_local_task_initial_relationships.max_total_ids

inside UoW revalidate every selected LLD-03 Service Request/RFC/Device Reference identity still exists; RFC target may be root or subordinate and archival/presentation state does not by itself invalidate the Task relationship
allocate task_id plus optional plan/link identities in canonical relationship-kind then target-id order
insert receipt then Local Task
when schedule supplied append task_plan_revision and current pointer
insert selected Task-owned active relationships
audit one task.created.v1 event with minimal Task plus optional plan/task_relationship result refs and commit
after commit request grouping recompute for any schedulable future noncancelled Task
rules: Task may remain unscheduled
no Objective is silently created/joined by this mutation; grouping remains a separately reviewed proposal
no fabricated TK identity

initial relationship selections have set semantics: caller order is not semantic, duplicates reject rather than silently deduplicate, and later relationships remain available through ChangeTaskRelationship without a business maximum

commands.name: RegisterManualWfmTask
steps: validate TK+14 and optional schedule
inside UoW classify task_no using WfmTaskRepository.task_no_status and load exact RFC/current lifecycle
if RETIRED return WFM_TASK_NO_RETIRED before receipt/domain mutation
if ACTIVE under the same RFC return semantic NO_CHANGE/adoption target; differing current parent requires ReassignWfmParent review
if ABSENT require active WFM RFC eligibility, allocate task_id, insert receipt, Task(kind=wfm), WFM identity and initial RFC assignment event
optional operational plan is manual evidence only and never provider source plan
audit and commit
request grouping recompute when eligible
rules: if RFC does not exist, the enclosing UI flow first uses LLD-03 CreateOrAdoptRfcIdentity to create the provisional RFC; an orphan provisional RFC after later WFM failure is valid and never silently deleted
exact later source Task No. adopts an ACTIVE manual task in place
a RETIRED Task No. is permanent nonreuse authority and can never be manually registered or source-adopted again

commands.name: ReassignWfmParent
steps: pure-preflight require canonical task_id/new_rfc_id UUIDv4 text, positive integer task_revision/assignment_revision/current_rfc_revision/new_rfc_revision, nonnegative integer current_rfc_source_projection_revision/new_rfc_source_projection_revision, bounded one-line nonempty reason_category (1..128 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL/CR/LF), and strict boolean accept_high_risk

inside UoW load exact Task plus WFM identity/current parent; missing Task/WFM identity returns TASK_NOT_FOUND, task revision mismatch returns TASK_STALE, and assignment revision mismatch returns WFM_PARENT_STALE

load the assignment-current RFC and candidate RFC exact current rfcs.revision plus rfc_current_source_projection.revision, representing absent source projection as revision 0; any mismatch against current_rfc_revision/current_rfc_source_projection_revision/new_rfc_revision/new_rfc_source_projection_revision returns WFM_PARENT_STALE before receipt/domain mutation
if new_rfc_id already equals current_rfc_id return semantic NO_CHANGE only after the exact Task, assignment and RFC hierarchy/lifecycle revisions are proven current; create no audit/history row

classify current history risk deterministically as HIGH iff this Task has any accepted task_plan_revisions, wfm_source_projection_cache authority, objective_membership_events, task_execution_events, task_retry_relations as predecessor or successor, or task_outcome_events; otherwise LOW; a current/projection row that cannot be reconciled to its required owned history fails closed as WFM_PARENT_STALE rather than downgrading risk
when risk is HIGH require accept_high_risk=true or return WFM_PARENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED before receipt/domain mutation
require the exact revalidated candidate RFC to be currently active/nonterminal; missing, archived or terminal candidate returns WFM_RFC_NOT_ELIGIBLE
insert receipt
atomically update current_rfc_id and assignment_revision, increment Task revision once, and append one assignment event with exact prior/new RFC, reason_category and computed review_risk
recompute derived root/SR context only as read/projection consequence; do not mutate RFC hierarchy/revisions, Objective membership, Task plan, source projection, execution, retry or outcome history
audit one task.wfm_parent_reassigned.v1 event and commit
rules: does not create WFM hierarchy flags
source-owned parent conflict may enter through LLD-04 review but uses the same service semantics
accept_high_risk is an explicit authorization boolean, never a caller-supplied risk classification; the service always recomputes LOW/HIGH from current writer-UoW authority

rfcs.revision is the hierarchy/reference freshness authority and rfc_current_source_projection.revision is the independent source-lifecycle freshness authority for this mutation; source projection revision 0 means the row is absent and later creation is a stale change
both assignment-current and candidate RFC freshness inputs are required so a terminal/lifecycle or hierarchy change on either side cannot be crossed by a previously reviewed reassignment
material reassignment increments tasks.revision and wfm_task_identities.assignment_revision exactly once; NO_CHANGE increments neither

commands.name: SetExplicitTaskLock
steps: pure-preflight require canonical task_id UUIDv4 text, positive integer task_revision, nonnegative integer lock_projection_revision, exact lock_kind plan|membership, exact action lock|unlock, and bounded one-line nonempty reason_category (1..128 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL/CR/LF)

inside one writer UnitOfWork load exact Task and task_lock_projection; missing Task returns TASK_NOT_FOUND, task revision mismatch returns TASK_STALE, projection absence is represented only by lock_projection_revision=0, and any projection presence/revision mismatch returns TASK_STALE before receipt/domain mutation

derive the requested dimension's current explicit state from task_lock_projection, treating absent projection as both explicit_plan_lock=false and explicit_membership_lock=false; if requested action already equals that explicit state return semantic NO_CHANGE only after exact Task/projection freshness and append no lock event/audit

for plan unlock, fail closed with TASK_PLAN_LOCKED before receipt if accepted non-correction Task execution exists; current terminal WFM source authority for the exact source_projection_revision is unresolved/protected (pending review exists or no exact retain_local_work resolution exists); or current Objective authority is historical_provider_complete, superseded, in_progress, awaiting_review, reviewed or otherwise terminal/protected such that plan authority is independently frozen

for membership unlock, fail closed with TASK_MEMBERSHIP_LOCKED before receipt if the Task has accepted non-correction execution; current terminal WFM source authority is unresolved/protected for the exact source_projection_revision; or current Objective membership belongs to an in_progress, awaiting_review, reviewed, historical_structure or superseded/protected Objective where regrouping is independently constrained; current/projection rows that cannot be reconciled to same-Task owned history fail closed rather than permitting unlock
insert receipt only after the selected dimension is proven eligible for the requested explicit-state change

append exactly one task_lock_events row, create task_lock_projection at revision 1 when previously absent or update only the selected explicit dimension and advance projection revision exactly once, preserve the other explicit dimension, and increment tasks.revision exactly once
audit one task.lock_changed.v1 event with exact lock_event result ref, selected lock_kind/action, resulting Task revision and resulting lock projection revision; commit atomically
rules: explicit lock state and effective derived locking are different authorities: an explicit unlock only changes the selected explicit boolean and never removes or rewrites execution, source-terminal, Objective, membership or other protected history
an ineffective unlock is rejected before receipt and never appends a misleading unlock event
lock_projection_revision=0 means exact absence; later projection creation makes that request stale
explicit lock history is durable and current time never creates, clears or changes a lock automatically
material explicit lock/unlock increments tasks.revision and task_lock_projection.revision exactly once; semantic NO_CHANGE increments neither
the non-selected explicit dimension is preserved exactly on every material mutation

commands.name: ChangeTaskRelationship
steps: inside UoW load Task and exact target
reject direct SR/RFC relationship on WFM; WFM SR/RFC context derives through owning RFC
Device Reference valid for either Task kind
if requested current state already holds use semantic NO_CHANGE
insert receipt then append/open or close relationship state preserving prior row
audit and commit
rules: Objective context recalculates only as derived view
regularized Device remains same Device Reference relationship

commands.name: ReviewWfmActivityRelationship
steps: load all exact distinct TK identities and current intervals/source/lifecycle state
insert receipt

distinct_activity records separate/no shared lineage; same_activity assigns reviewed shared lineage; retry_lineage additionally requires legal immediate predecessor/successor relation; unresolved_source_error preserves identities and conflict warning
recompute competing-attempt conflict projection from shared lineage + overlapping active intervals
audit decision and commit
rules: overlapping active attempts in one reviewed lineage remain a blocking conflict until reviewed resolution changes lifecycle/lineage
never collapse Task identities or create overlapping Objectives to evade conflict

commands.name: CreateLocalTaskRetry
input: new task name or inherited reviewed name
steps: require predecessor has no direct successor and validate new schedule
outside lock preview selected owned relationships and optional LLD-07 participant impact
inside UoW revalidate predecessor/successor eligibility and selected relationship states
allocate new task_id
insert receipt, new Local Task, retry relation, retry-clone plan revision and selected Task-owned links
when Inventory selections supplied call LLD-07 participant in same UoW; unavailable/indeterminate fails closed
audit new attempt/predecessor refs and commit
request normal grouping recompute
rules: predecessor is never rewritten
new Task enters Objective only through normal reviewed grouping
no one-to-one Objective retry chain

commands.name: LinkWfmRetryAttempt
steps: inside UoW prove both are distinct WFM identities, predecessor has no successor and successor has no predecessor
insert receipt/retry relation
assign/reconcile reviewed activity lineage
recompute competing-attempt conflict
audit and commit
commands.rule: new provider attempt must already possess its distinct canonical TK identity; this command never fabricates one
